raw_response:
*I sit down on the step with my cup of hot water and think through this year's planting.*

Ai, I'm 62 now, forty years on this dirt. My husband and me, just the two of us at home most days — kids are in the city. We got 12 mu. Same as always, I split it: the four mu in the lower field by the drainage ditch, that's my cotton ground — the soil there is a bit salty, wheat doesn't do as well there, but cotton puts up with it. The other eight mu is good land, that's my wheat-maize ground, one crop after the other, been doing it that way for many years now.

**Wheat** — I plant right after the maize comes off in October, around the 10th or 15th, whenever the ground dries enough to plow. I buy seed from the village co-op, nothing fancy, the same kind my neighbor plants. Before plowing I spread one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that's 40 kg a bag, the blue bag. Then at spring green-up I topdress urea, about half a bag per mu, and water it in. I water three times if heaven gives rain, four if it doesn't — once before freezing, once at green-up, once at heading. Each watering the electric for the well costs money, so I don't water more than I need. If weeds come up I spray once with that herbicide the shop sells, the cheap one. Last year I got about 400 kg per mu. Should be similar this year if no bad weather.

**Maize** — June, right when wheat is cut, the combine leaves, we have maybe four days. I hire the old Zhang with the planter to come through — costs me 30 yuan a mu but we can't do it by hand at our age anymore. I put compound fertilizer down with the seed, one bag per mu again. When it's knee-high I topdress urea, a bit less than for wheat since it grows fast in summer. I water once or twice if the rain doesn't come. Maize is easier than wheat — not much spraying, just keep the weeds down between rows. I expect around 450 kg per mu, same as last year.

**Cotton** — this one I know in my bones. Plant end of April, after the cold snap has passed. I use the seed I buy from the seed shop, the Bt kind, because bollworm was terrible before that came out. Base fertilizer one bag compound per mu. When flowers start, I topdress urea. Cotton needs spraying — I spray two or three times in July-August for bollworm and aphids. It's the spraying and picking that's the work. Water once or twice in July if it's dry. My daughter-in-law comes from town on weekends to help pick, and for the big September picking I hire two village women for a week. Picking cotton — my back can't do all four mu alone anymore. I expect around 250 kg of lint per mu. Price has been so-so lately, but cotton is what I know.

Total money going out for inputs, I figure around 6,000 yuan for the year, give or take. That's the biggest single cost after living expenses. I keep some in reserve — you never know when the well pump breaks or someone gets sick.
